errors.evidence: The description for Line 1 states that it drops to about 22% from 2010. However, the chart shows that the value for Line 1 (blue, star) is around 27% in 2010 and never drops below 25% during the entire period.
The description for Line 1 claims it stabilizes at about 24% from 2015 onwards. The chart shows the value is stable at a higher level, around 26%.
The description for Line 2 (blue, circle) claims it stabilizes at about 11% from 2015. In reality, the line drops sharply starting around 2014 to a value of about 8.5% by 2020.

errors.evidence: The description for Line 3 (blue, triangle) claims it rises to about 15% by the year 2000. The chart shows the value in 2000 is approximately 12.5%.
The description for Line 3 states that it stabilizes at about 11% from 2015. The chart shows a clear and strong upward trend in this period, rising from about 12% in 2015 to nearly 20% by 2020.
The description for Line 4 (blue, square) says it begins at about 23%. The chart clearly shows it begins at 25%.
The description for Line 4 states it rises to 24% from 2005. The chart shows the peak of ~24% occurred around 2001, and by 2005 the value was back down to ~23%.
The description for Line 4 claims it falls to about 19% from 2010. The value in 2010 is about 22%, and it never drops to 19% in the time period shown.
